title: Adios and RiskMandate

scenes.kicker: RiskMandate · a story made at the summit
scenes.title: Adios and RiskMandate
scenes.caption: For Adios

scenes.text: "Give the agent enough context to work, without giving it the platform."
scenes.caption: Adios's own principle, from its public pages.
say: Adios is an AI cloud platform where agents work in a scoped, isolated workspace.
That one sentence is the whole design: enough context to work, not the platform.

scenes.title: From the customer's side, the agent just connects
steps: Isolated cloud workspace builds the app
scenes.caption: The agent runs inside Adios over MCP; the customer keeps the tools they already use.
say: The customer keeps their agent. Adios sits behind MCP.
Nothing goes live until the user approves.

scenes.title: The same agent, bare versus on Adios

before.label: Bare agent
items: On a developer's laptop, it reaches everything the developer can
The mandate is whatever was typed in a prompt
No measured record of what it could reach

after.label: On Adios (its own pages)
items: Scoped file, Git, task, preview and log operations
No general browser shell or platform credentials
Secrets resolved only for the path that needs them

scenes.caption: Built from public pages only; nothing of Adios's was tested.
say: Adios shrinks what an agent can reach. That is the claim on its own pages.
What we would add is the measurement of that shrinkage.

scenes.title: A table of reach, to be filled by measurement

rows.text: secret:// refs, resolved per build or runtime path
Sandboxes: namespaces, cgroups, limits where supported

scenes.caption: No numbers yet: the gap is unknown until it is measured.
say: The mandate is the written task: edit these files, run this task, return a reviewable change.
Reach is what the agent can actually do. The gap is the difference, and we would put a figure on it.

scenes.title: What we would do together
steps: Write the mandate for a declared task
scenes.caption: A proposal for working together, not a claim by Adios.
say: Same task, same agent, two settings.
The output is evidence Adios can show, instead of a sentence on a page.

scenes.title: What we would be careful to say
items: Everything about Adios here comes from its own public pages
The size of the gap is unknown until measured
SOC 2 and ISO 27001 work is underway; the reports are not final yet
Isolation features apply where the runtime supports them
scenes.caption: Stated plainly, so the measurement can be trusted.
scenes.source: Adios public pages, including its security page
say: We would rather state limits than overclaim.
Adios's own security page says its audit reports are not final.

scenes.text: Adios shrinks what an agent can reach. Measured against the same agent bare, that shrinking gap becomes the business case.
scenes.caption: Our hypothesis: the gap, measured and evidenced.
say: Adios does the shrinking. We would measure it.

scenes.title: Three ways to start
items: £500 · ABP Tailored: your deployment, reflected in the mandate, corrected by a named security professional (1 to 3 days)
£1,500 · ABP Reviewed: two sessions with your team and a custom vault, signed off by a security professional (1 to 5 days)
£5,000 · A deeper engagement: your agents mapped, mandated and measured with us, end to end
Summit promotion: commit today and take 25% off any of these, or, with the £1,500 or £5,000 package, a tablet set up for you.
scenes.caption: agent@riskmandate.ai · store.sgit.ai
say: Pick the level that fits: tailored, reviewed, or end to end.
